name: Cipla Nicotex Nicotine Sugar Free Mint Plus Gums 2Mg 12 Gums Each Pack - Helps To Quit Smoking - Who - Approved Therapy
description:
Cipla Nicotex Nicotine Sugar-Free Gum 2mg – Mint Plus

Take the first step toward a smoke-free life with Cipla Nicotex Nicotine Gum. Designed to help you quit smoking, this WHO-approved nicotine replacement therapy (NRT) supports a 12-week program to reduce dependence on cigarettes while doubling your chances of success.

Key Features:

Helps Quit Smoking: Supports a gradual reduction in nicotine dependence.

WHO-Approved Therapy: Clinically recognized and safe.

Doctor Recommended: India’s No. 1 recommended brand by doctors.

Sugar-Free & Flavored: Mint Plus flavor, available in other variants: Paan, Cinnamon, Fruit Burst, and Ultra Mint.

Pack Size: 12 gums per pack

12-Week Program: Structured therapy to guide you toward a smoke-free life.

Regain control and live healthier with Cipla Nicotex Nicotine Gum – Mint Plus.
